summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom the Fates killed with brazen clubs in the Gigantomachy.

story.text: Apollodorus names Agrius among the Giants destroyed when the gods fought with Heracles' aid: the Fates, fighting with brazen clubs, killed Agrius and Thoas. The collective node `gigantes` holds the earthborn revolt; this node is the individual in the battle roster — distinct from Agrius son of Porthaon in the Calydonian genealogy.
